title: Książ Hochberg avenue park gate
visualBrief: Chamfered sandstone pillars and urns, curved iron opening and low curved wing walls ending in simplified sphinx-like sculptures.

nativeAxes.longitudinal: +Z through the gate away from the linked photograph viewpoint; curved wings on the photographed −Z side.
nativeAxes.origin: Mapped pedestrian opening center; Y0 is the retained Terrarium elevation at the gate node.

sourceFacts.primaryDescription: Independent heritage gate node with map-linked primary photograph. Own point and adjoining path define the proposed axis; pillars, wing walls and ornamental proportions are original photographic interpretations.

reconstruction.basis: Own mapped gate point and adjacent path control vertices; original exterior interpretation of source photographs.
reconstruction.scope: One of three park gates in ksiaz_castle_and_park_complex; other site structures remain incomplete.
reconstruction.registration: The fork beyond the opening fixes the photographed Hochberg Alley facing. The iron leaves are shown open with the paved route retained. Foundations and wings follow the local slope.

Map data locates the opening and adjoining path only. Widths, heights and wing-wall curves are photographic estimates.
Exterior and ornaments follow the linked 2014 photograph. Leaves are shown open. Their position in use varies.
Urns, scrolls, putti and hybrid sculptures are simplified original medium-fi forms, without facial likenesses, lettering or sculpted microdetail.
No independent Wikidata identifier, unique textures or redistributed reference photos.
Original terrain supplies the local grade. Widths and details remain photographic estimates. Physical-device timing remains pending.
